rows.text: The key to piloting Celes, Rune Knight is understanding its core engine: Celes discards and draws on entry, and buffs your entire team with +1/+1 counters whenever creatures enter from or are cast from a graveyard, synergizing with reanimation spells and recursive creatures.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Smothering Tithe, Demonic Tutor, Jeska's Will. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
